schema.description: RoleRef contains information that points to the role being used

apiGroup.description: APIGroup is the group for the resource being referenced

kind.description: Kind is the type of resource being referenced

description: Please note that the role reference is configured to use the **rbac.authorization.k8s.io** API group. It points to a resource of kind **Role**, specifically the role named **pod-reader**. This configuration ensures that the appropriate permissions for reading pod information are granted through the designated role.
